segments.sn23.35:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ rādhaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn23.35:1.3: “yo kho, rādha, māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn23.35:1.5: Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe … viññāṇaṃ māro;
segments.sn23.35:1.6: tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe … yo kho, rādha, māro;
segments.sn23.35:1.7: tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti.
segments.sn23.36:1.1: Yo kho, rādha, māradhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo … pe ….
segments.sn23.45:1.1: Yo kho, rādha, samudayadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo … pe ….
